# Initiative ratings

Used in [Sequence of play](/rules/20-sequence-of-play).

## Commonwealth

| Turns | Rating |
|---|---|
| 1–42 | 3 |
| 43–90 | 4 |
| 91–111 | 5 |

## Axis

| Situation | Rating |
|---|---|
| rommel on map | 6 |
| german land combat units no rommel | 3 |
| no german combat units | 1 |

## Notes

- Each side's initiative rating is added to one die at the start of every game turn (SPI 7.1x, rules/20-sequence-of-play.md). The Commonwealth rating rises with the calendar; the Axis rating depends on whether Rommel, or failing him any German land combat unit, is on the game maps — units in the Tripoli/Tunisia holding boxes on map A do not count (chart note)
- Transcribed from the archive.org scan (jp2 96) and cross-checked against the 300 dpi community scan of the chart sheet (scan:discord:Shared Charts.pdf:p2): 0 of 6 rows differ. Clay Stone's errata-integrated Land rules PDF contains no chart sheet
